title: Text: DET Alan Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: And do you have an office in your window?
I’m writing my things I’ll remember about the season column
“Doing karaoke at the Barley House in Cleveland, singing the Remix To Ignition, hot and fresh out the kitchen. Everybody in baseball, one player said, knows about the Barley House.”
I was running downtown today, that’s why I asked. Was gonna run by and shame you
